What we install

Clean power, fitted properly.

From a single home roof to a shop, school or farm, we survey, design, install and look after the system.

Home rooftop systems

Panels sized to your roof and your KPLC bill, mounted securely and wired to code.

Hybrid inverters & batteries

Store the day's sun and keep lights, fridge and Wi-Fi running through outages.

Commercial & carports

Larger arrays for shops, offices, schools and farms, including shaded parking structures.

Maintenance & checks

Cleaning, inspections and performance checks so your system keeps producing.

How it works

From site visit to switch-on.

Site visit

We check your roof, shading, wiring and what you pay for power today.

Design & quote

You get a clear system layout and price, with panel, inverter and battery options.

Installation

Switch-on & aftercare
